jobs.title: Senior Product Manager, AI Receptionist
jobs.jd_full:
Who is Boulevard?

Boulevard provides the first and only client experience platform for appointment-based, self-care businesses. We empower our customers to give their clients more of the magical moments that matter most.

Before launching in 2016, our founders spent months interviewing salon managers and working behind front desks to understand their pain points so we could design a modern, user-friendly platform that meets the unique needs of their business. Our roots may be in hair salons, but we are built for the broader self-care industry, including many types of salons, spas, medspa, barbershops, and more. Our technology not only helps our customers survive but thrive. Take a look at how we (and YOU) can make that happen.

We have an insatiable curiosity and embrace experimentation. We believe that simple solutions require the most sophistication, and we design each and every detail to maximize potential, power, and impact. Do our values match? Read through our story and what we value the most.

Our team values and celebrates our diverse backgrounds. Being open about who we are and what we do allows us to do the best work of our lives. We believe in equal opportunity for all, and you should too.

Come do the best work of your life at Boulevard. Boulevard is the client experience platform purpose-built for salons, spas, medspas, and wellness businesses. More than 5,000 businesses use Boulevard — processing over $5 billion in payments annually. We've raised $188M in funding and are scaling fast, with growing ambitions in enterprise and multi-location operators.

Every salon, spa, and medspa deserves a front desk that never misses a call, never drops a message, and always knows what to say. Boulevard's AI Receptionist is building that — agentic AI that handles client communication across voice and text so businesses can grow faster, operate leaner, and deliver an exceptional experience every time. This role owns that vision end-to-end.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

Own the AI Receptionist product end-to-end

  • You'll set the vision, roadmap, and success criteria for Boulevard's AI Receptionist suite — our answer to the modern contact center for self-care businesses. That means owning how AI engages clients in 1:1 interactions across voice and text: when it handles conversations autonomously, when it hands off to staff, and how that transition feels invisible to the client and effortless for the team.

Define what great AI-powered client communication looks like

  • You'll develop a deep point of view on where AI should handle interactions autonomously, where it should hand off to staff, and how to make that transition seamless — including how conversations maintain continuity across channels, how fallback behaviors are designed when AI can't resolve something, and how the overall experience feels coherent whether a client is talking to AI or a human.

Drive adoption and outcomes

  • You'll own the business outcomes for the AI Receptionist — revenue, adoption, and retention — and define the product metrics that drive them: autonomous resolution rate, agent productivity, CSAT, and more. You'll collaborate on pricing strategy and be expected to connect what's happening in the product to what it means for their business.

Represent the customer

  • You'll develop genuine fluency with how self-care businesses manage client communication today — what they trust, what they fear, what they'd delegate in a heartbeat and what they'd never let out of human hands. That customer insight is what separates AI that gets adopted from AI that gets turned off.

WHAT YOU'LL BRING

  • 5–8 years in product management with experience in B2B2C or both B2C and B2B environments — you understand what it means to serve a business and their end customer simultaneously
  • Experience shipping AI-powered products — you know how to shape how AI behaves, design for when it falls short, and earn user trust over time
  • LLM fluency — enough hands-on familiarity with LLMs and prompt design to partner credibly with engineering without needing a translator
  • AI-native in your own practice — you're using tools like Claude daily, running side projects, and staying genuinely close to how the technology is evolving
  • Strong voice-of-customer instincts — you've built products for users who are skeptical of automation and know how to design for trust
  • Data fluency — you're comfortable defining metrics, pulling your own analysis, and building the case for roadmap bets with evidence
  • Cross-functional leadership — you've influenced engineering, design, and data teams without relying on authority, and you've kept multiple workstreams moving in parallel
  • Clear communication — you can translate complex AI product decisions into terms that resonate with business owners, cross-functional partners, and leadership alike

PREFERRED

  • Experience with conversational AI, voice interfaces, or messaging products
  • Experience in vertical SaaS or services-industry platforms
  • Familiarity with AI quality evaluation — you've thought about how to measure and improve AI conversation quality, not just ship it
  • A genuine affinity for small businesses — you understand their constraints and what it takes to earn their trust

WHY THIS ROLE MATTERS

The AI Receptionist is one of Boulevard's highest-visibility bets. For a self-care business, the front-of-house experience — answering calls, responding to texts, knowing when to bring a human in — is where client relationships are made or broken. AI that gets this right is transformative. AI that gets it wrong damages trust overnight.

This role is a rare opportunity to build an AI product that has a direct, tangible impact on how thousands of small businesses show up for their clients — at a company that's well-funded, growing fast, and early enough in its AI journey that this PM will genuinely shape the direction.

Compensation

At Boulevard, we work hard to structure compensation in a way that balances internal equity with local market competitiveness, and we’re happy to share a good-faith estimate of the base salary range for this role. For candidates in NYC, the SF Bay Area, and Seattle, the anticipated base salary range is $129,000 - $161,300 per year. For all other U.S. locations, the anticipated base salary range is $113,400 - $155,900 per year. In addition to this base compensation, this role may be eligible to participate in a variable compensation program. Final compensation will vary based on a variety of factors which include but are not limited to applicable experience, location, and final leveling.

In addition to the wonderful people you’ll get to work with and challenging projects that’ll push you - Boulevard is here to make sure you’re always at the top of your game emotionally, mentally, and physically.

  • ✨ We’ve got you covered with a 401(k) match plus dental, medical, vision, and life insurance.

  • Take a break whenever you need with our flexible vacation day policy.

  • Fully remote so you can choose where you want to work. You’ll receive a work from home stipend every month.

  • Family planning resources and specialized support programs.

  • Equity: get ahead on the ground floor and grow with Boulevard.

  • Boulevard Bucks Learning and Development program allows employees to explore businesses in the market we serve.

We recommend following our official LinkedIn page to stay up to date on all things Boulevard life!

Boulevard Labs, Inc. is an Equal Opportunity Employer committed to hiring a diverse workforce and sustaining an inclusive culture. All employment decisions at Boulevard Labs, Inc. are based on business needs, job requirements, and individual qualifications, without regard to race, color, religion, marital status, age, national origin, ancestry, physical or mental disability, medical condition, pregnancy, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, veteran status, or any other status protected under federal, state, or local law.

jobs.title: Category Manager Asian & Tribal Arts
jobs.jd_full:
At Catawiki, every day brings the extraordinary! Whether it’s Daniel Ricciardo’s Formula 1 Car, a Woolly Mammoth’s Skeleton, Lady Gaga's Jumpsuit or Usain Bolt’s running shoe, we encounter exceptional objects every day.

We’re a one-of-a-kind marketplace for buying and selling special objects. Each week, more than 100,000 unique items are auctioned, all carefully curated by our passionate in-house experts.

Having sold over 25 million unique objects, our mission is to become the world’s most popular destination for special objects. As a growing, diverse and sustainable scale-up, we proudly live by three core values. If these values resonate with you, we’d love to explore how you can join us.

  • Taking ownership and driving impact
  • Being open to change and feedback
  • Being passionate about our mission and our customers.

Asian & Tribal is one of the most culturally rich and commercially complex categories within Collectables. It spans Asian Art, Tribal & Ethnographic Art, and related subcategories where heritage, craftsmanship, provenance, and collector trust are critical. The category attracts a diverse global buyer base ranging from emerging collectors to highly specialised, repeat buyers, and requires strong judgement, commercial sharpness, and leadership to balance growth with quality.

This is an opportunity to lead an established category with real depth, a strong expert team and clear headroom for growth. You will set the commercial direction, turn opportunity into focused execution and build a category that grows in both scale and quality. It is not a role for maintaining the status quo: you will make choices, create momentum and take ownership of the outcomes.

As Category Manager, you own the category strategy and commercial performance. You lead and develop an international team of Experts, build strong external networks with sellers and institutions, and ensure a high-quality buyer experience that reinforces trust and repeat engagement.

This role is based in the Netherlands with a hybrid setup. You are expected to work from the Amsterdam office two days per week to collaborate closely with other Category Managers, Commercial teams, and key stakeholders.

The Opportunity

  • Shape a clear growth plan for a category with global reach, cultural credibility and significant untapped commercial potential.
  • Improve the category mix, auction performance and seller portfolio - choosing where to invest, what to stop and how to turn insight into measurable action.
  • Build a stronger, more repeatable pipeline of high-quality sellers alongside Sales and Business Development, while representing Catawiki credibly in the market.
  • Create a high-performing, engaged team that combines specialist expertise with commercial ownership, pace and accountability.

What You’ll Do

  • Build, own and execute the strategic growth plan for Asian & Tribal. Set a clear ambition, identify the few growth bets that matter most and translate them into practical, time-bound execution.
  • Own the category P&L and commercial outcomes. Use data to make firm calls on where to invest, improve or stop - balancing growth, margin, quality and operational stability.
  • Steer the full auction-performance funnel: supply quality and mix, curation pace, pricing and reserve-price strategy, sell-through, cancellation and buyer experience.
  • Shape auction planning around seasonality, market dynamics, collector behaviour and seller portfolios, with a focus on increasing repeatable high-quality supply and long-term buyer trust.
  • Work closely with Sales and Business Development to build and convert a stronger seller pipeline. Develop your own external network and represent Catawiki with credibility among sellers, dealers, institutions and professional networks.
  • Lead, coach and develop an international team of Experts. Set clear expectations, create ownership and follow through on performance, development and accountability.
  • Create focus and pace in a complex environment. Prioritise clearly, make decisions with imperfect information and address resistance or underperformance directly and constructively.
  • Influence Marketing, Operations, Product, Commercial and other Category teams to unlock growth opportunities. Build alignment where it helps execution, but do not wait for consensus to move the business forward.
  • Stay close to global Asian & Tribal market trends, pricing dynamics, collector demand and competitive movements, turning relevant insight into action.

What You’ll Bring

  • A strong commercial track record in category management, marketplace, retail, sales or another complex, customer-led business. You have owned meaningful commercial outcomes, not only supported them.
  • Experience building and executing a growth strategy, including planning, budgeting, pricing and P&L management. You can explain the commercial logic behind your decisions and measure whether they worked.
  • A data-led, action-oriented approach. You can move from dashboards and ambiguous signals to a clear diagnosis, a prioritised plan and accountable follow-through.
  • Proven people-leadership experience. You know how to coach specialists, set a high bar, create engagement and handle difficult performance conversations when needed.
  • Commercial curiosity and entrepreneurial energy. You actively look for opportunities, test assumptions and keep learning - particularly where the market or customer behaviour is changing.
  • Decisiveness and resilience in a fast-paced, high-expectation environment. You are comfortable making trade-offs, defending a point of view and adapting when evidence says the approach needs to change.
  • Strong stakeholder management and communication skills. You can influence across seniority levels and functions, communicate concisely and bring people with you through change.
  • A hands-on mindset balanced with strategic thinking. You are willing to get close to the detail when needed, while building systems and capability that allow the team to scale.
  • Comfort working with Google Suite or similar tools.
  • Interest or background in Asian Art, Tribal Art or Collectables is a plus. Deep expertise can grow on the job; commercial leadership, judgement and the ability to build trust are essential.

What Success Looks Like

  • A focused, credible category growth plan is in motion, with clear priorities, owners, milestones and leading indicators.
  • The team understands what good looks like and works with greater clarity, ownership and commercial pace.
  • Auction quality and commercial discipline are more consistent, with deliberate choices on supply mix, pricing and reserve-price strategy.
  • A stronger pipeline of repeat, high-quality sellers is being built with Commercial partners and through your own market network.
  • Stakeholders experience you as a clear, constructive business owner who moves decisions into action and communicates progress honestly.

Where You’ll Be

This is a hybrid role based in the Netherlands. You will work from the Amsterdam office at least two days per week to collaborate with fellow Category Managers, Commercial teams, and key stakeholders.

What We Offer

A category with cultural depth, global reach, and significant commercial potential. You will have real ownership, the space to shape strategy and execution, and the opportunity to lead and develop a strong expert team. You will work alongside ambitious international colleagues in a collaborative environment with clear expectations, strong development opportunities, and a focus on sustainable growth.

Why You'll Love Working with Us

  • Create a visible impact by working at scale in a global organisation serving millions of customers across 80+ categories. In our flat structure, every role has a broad scope and directly impacts both our customers and the business.
  • Learn and grow through our Learning & Development initiatives, including clear development plans and mentorship programmes to support your career progression.
  • A culture of connection defines us. We’re a passionate, diverse team of 800+ Catawikians representing 60+ nationalities. We foster an inclusive and queer-friendly environment where everyone is encouraged to bring their full self to work.
  • Celebrate life’s moments with us. You’ll receive a €100 Catavoucher when you join, a €50 Catavoucher on your birthday, and an extra day off each year to “Pursue Your Passion”. We also offer additional leave for key work anniversaries and important life events. Benefits may vary by location.

Our Offices and Way of Working

Our vibrant offices in Amsterdam and Lisbon are designed to inspire collaboration. Most Catawikians operate in a hybrid setup, combining office-based and remote work, with a minimum of two days per week in the office, unless a role is explicitly stated as fully remote or fully office-based.

Interested?

Apply with an English CV and Cover Letter. By applying, you agree to Catawiki’s Applicant Privacy Policy. If you’re excited about this role but don’t meet every requirement, we still encourage you to apply anyway. You may be just the right candidate for this or other roles.

The ideal candidate will have a deep understanding of trucking operations and a passion for ensuring the highest quality of our software products. While extensive tech experience is not required, a willingness to learn and adapt to new tools and technologies is essential.

  • Collaborate closely with the development team to provide timely feedback based on industry expertise.

  • Analyze test results, report on testing progress and outcomes, and suggest improvements.

  • Continuously improve testing processes, tools, and methodologies.

  • Participate in code reviews and provide feedback from a QA perspective.

Requirements:

  • Basic understanding of software QA methodologies, tools, and processes.

  • Willingness to learn and adapt to new testing frameworks and tools.

  • Strong attention to detail and problem-solving skills.

  • Excellent communication skills and the ability to work effectively in a remote team.

  • Familiarity with Agile development processes is a plus.

  • Basic knowledge of SQL and scripting is a plus.

jobs.title: Program Manager, AI Agent & Support Automation
jobs.jd_full:
Bullhorn's core purpose is to create an incredible customer experience, and the organization has a sharp focus on delivering very high quality products and services to its customers. The company culture is shaped by five Core Values: Ownership, Energy, Speed & Agility, Service, and Being Human. Each value, and its underlying definition, serves as a behavioral guide for employees as they interact with customers and fellow coworkers and is an embedded way of operating across our organization.

Bullhorn is a fast-paced and dynamic environment where hard work and outstanding results are rewarded and celebrated. We value those that exhibit an eagerness to learn and a strong natural desire for continuous improvement and we encourage team members to stretch themselves, acknowledge challenges and learn from them. With a strong focus on growth, we provide ample opportunities for career development and prioritize promoting from within. We believe that leaders should care deeply about the development of their employees at all levels, emphasizing emotional intelligence and accountability. Our leaders collaborate closely to ensure the success of their teams, and we work together to achieve shared goals, creating a challenging and rewarding workplace for everyone.

ABOUT THE ROLE

This is a builder role at the intersection of AI, customer experience, and operational excellence. You'll be the single accountable owner of Sophia, Bullhorn Support's customer-facing self-service AI agent (built on Salesforce Agentforce), driving measurable case deflection while keeping the customer experience excellent.

You'll inherit strong foundational tooling but will need to diagnose gaps, tune the agent, establish guardrails and governance, and build the measure-and-improve cadences that make self-service durable at scale. This role owns and tunes the system; it doesn't require building it from scratch or writing production code.


WHAT YOU'LL OWN

  • End-to-end ownership of Sophia: configuration, prompting, performance, and success, including subagents, topics, actions, routing, escalation-to-case, and guardrails.
  • Designing, testing, and iterating the prompts and instructions that drive the agent's behavior, tone, and accuracy, validated in sandbox with regression testing before every production release.
  • Case deflection and containment targets: defining them, driving them, and reporting on them, while protecting CSAT.
  • Production monitoring and QA: reviewing transcripts, tracking accuracy and drift, and catching regressions early.
  • Guardrails, human-in-the-loop policies, and responsible-AI practices, with a rollback plan for every change.
  • Connecting internal and external self-service, and representing Support's needs into Bullhorn's internal AI knowledge initiative.
  • Partnering across Support Operations, CX Data & Analytics, Enablement, and platform/vendor contacts, and providing executive-level updates on self-service performance.

WHAT YOU BRING

  • 4+ years in support operations, customer experience, conversational/AI design, or a self-service/deflection role at a SaaS or technology company, including hands-on ownership of a self-service or AI support capability.
  • Hands-on experience configuring, deploying, and tuning conversational AI agents in production (Agentforce strongly preferred), including Agent Script.
  • Prompt engineering experience: designing, testing, and iterating prompts to improve accuracy and behavior.
  • Proven case deflection results using self-service AI tooling, with the ability to use data and conversation analysis to evolve self-service over time.
  • Salesforce Service Cloud (case management) and Experience Cloud (customer portal) experience. •
  • Strong analytical skills, comfortable building dashboards/scorecards and translating metrics into recommendations.
  • Excellent written communication, including executive-level summaries.
  • Ability to operate as an individual contributor while influencing across functions, with product/project and change management experience.

NICE TO HAVE

  • Salesforce Administrator and/or Agentforce Specialist certification.
  • Low-code/scripting ability (Flow, APIs, JSON); builders and "vibe coders" welcome, production code not required.
  • Familiarity with KCS/knowledge management and how article quality affects AI deflection.
  • Experience with other AI-assisted support tools and BI/data-visualization tools (e.g., Snowflake, Tableau, Salesforce reports).
  • Background in staffing, HR tech, or enterprise SaaS, and experience supporting global teams across US and EMEA time zones.

The annual base salary range for this position is $150,000. In addition, this role is eligible for a target bonus & a comprehensive benefits package

Compensation and Transparency Statement

The posted range represents the good-faith estimate of what we expect to pay for this role at the time of this posting. We may ultimately pay more or less than the posted range, and the range may be modified in the future. Actual pay within the range will be based on factors such as, but not limited to, experience, skills, qualifications, geographic location, internal equity, and business or organizational needs and affordability. In accordance with state and local pay transparency laws we disclose salary ranges in all job postings and provide additional information upon request.

What we offer...

  • Benefits eligibility effective DAY ONE including Medical, Dental, Vision, 401(k), 401(k) Match, and more

  • Unlimited Planned Paid Time Off

  • Global Mental Health Support

  • On-Demand Learning & Development

  • Quarterly paid volunteer days

  • Lucrative Employee Referral Program (eligible for prior to your first day)

  • Company-wide mentor program

Bullhorn's core purpose is to create an incredible customer experience, and the organization has a sharp focus on delivering very high quality products and services to its customers. The company culture is shaped by five Core Values: Ownership, Energy, Speed & Agility, Service, and Being Human. Each value, and its underlying definition, serves as a behavioral guide for employees as they interact with customers and fellow coworkers and is an embedded way of operating across our organization.

We are a people-first culture where everyone’s contribution is valued and respected. We're looking for smart, forward-thinking individuals who aren't afraid to challenge the status quo and bring fresh perspectives to the table. If you're someone who thrives in a casual, yet fast-paced and agile environment, we'd love to have you join us.

jobs.title: Product Analyst
jobs.jd_full:
At LifeStance Health, we strive to help individuals, families, and communities with their mental health needs. Everywhere. Every day. It’s a lofty goal; we know. But we make it happen with the best team in mental healthcare.

Thank you for taking the time to explore a career with us. As the fastest growing mental health practice group in the country, now is the perfect time to join our team!

LifeStance Health Values

  • Belonging: We cultivate a space where everyone can show up as their authentic self.

  • Empathy: We seek out diverse perspectives and listen to learn without judgment.

  • Courage: We are all accountable for doing the right thing - even when it's hard - because we know it's worth it.

  • One Team: We realize our full potential when we work together towards our shared purpose.

Benefits
As a full-time employee of LifeStance Health, the following benefits are offered: medical, dental, vision, AD&D, short and long-term disability, and life insurance. Additional benefits include a 401k retirement savings with employer match, paid parental leave, paid time off, holiday pay and an Employee Assistance Program.

ROLE OVERVIEW

The Product Analyst (PA) plays a critical role in advancing LifeStance’s patient experience strategy by helping design and deliver product solutions that improve access, engagement, and outcomes across the patient journey. Partnering closely with Product Management, Engineering, Clinical Operations, and Data teams, this role translates patient and caregiver needs into actionable product requirements, insights, and delivery support.

This position sits at the intersection of product development and patient experience, contributing directly to initiatives that enhance patient access (e.g., scheduling, intake), engagement (e.g., digital touchpoints, communication), and continuity of care. The Product Analyst ensures that product decisions are grounded in data, informed by real patient workflows and behaviors, and aligned to measurable outcomes such as access, satisfaction, and care quality.

Success in this role means enabling teams to deliver intuitive, scalable, and compliant digital experiences that make it easier for patients to find, access, and stay engaged in care—while supporting LifeStance’s broader mission to improve access to high-quality mental healthcare.

COMPENSATION: $71,779 - $86,135/annually in addition to a competitive bonus plan

RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Core Product

  • Translate business and clinical needs into clear functional specifications, user stories, and acceptance criteria

  • Maintain and refine the product backlog in partnership with the Product Manager

  • Support roadmap planning through feasibility analysis, effort estimation, and dependency mapping

  • Data & Analytics

    • Query and analyze EHR, operational, and engagement data to inform product decisions

    • Partner with Data/BI teams to define and validate KPIs tied to product performance

  • Subject Matter Expertise

    • Develop working knowledge of patient workflows (e.g., scheduling, documentation, billing, care coordination)

    • Participate in workflow observation, user interviews, and stakeholder discovery sessions

  • Collaboration & Delivery Support

    • Act as a liaison between Engineering, Clinical Operations, Compliance, and IT

    • Support agile ceremonies (backlog grooming, sprint planning, retrospectives)

    • Track and communicate dependencies, risks, and action items across workstreams

  • Documentation & Communication

    • Maintain product documentation (process maps, decision logs, data dictionaries, system diagrams)

    • Prepare release notes, training materials, and stakeholder communications

    • Support the Product Manager with executive summaries, reporting, and meeting materials

SKILLS & EXPERIENCE

  • 1–4 years of experience in product analysis, business analysis, healthcare operations, or data analytics

  • Strong ability to translate business needs into structured requirements

  • Experience working with data (SQL, Excel, BI tools, or similar)

  • Excellent communication and organizational skills

Preferred Skills

  • Exposure to healthcare technology, EHR systems, or clinical workflows

  • Familiarity with agile product development methodologies

  • Understanding of interoperability standards (FHIR, APIs)

jobs.title: Senior Digital Program Manager
jobs.jd_full:
Our Mission:

6sense’s mission is to multiply what matters: growth, retention, and efficiency.  We envision a future where companies, teams and people reach their full potential.

Our People:

People are the heart and soul of 6sense. We serve with passion and purpose. We live by our Being 6sense values of Win as One Team, Stay Curious, Do The Right Thing, Own the Outcome, and Create Belonging.  Every 6sensor plays a part in deﬁning the future of our industry-leading technology.  6sense is a place where difference-makers roll up their sleeves, take risks, act with integrity, and measure success by the value we create for our customers.  We want 6sense to be the best chapter of your career.

About the Role

6sense is hiring a Senior Digital Program Manager to build and run the digital engagement engine for our Customer Success organization. This is a hybrid role: an expert-level Gainsight builder, program lead, and strategist. You will own the platform and, more importantly, You will own the platform and the quality of what gets built on it: the journeys, programs, and measurement that put CS strategy into action at scale. You are accountable for how they are built, for their accuracy, and for reporting on how they perform.Your primary focus will be to build and operate the digital programs that carry out CS strategy, report on where they are working and where customers are going unengaged, and recommend what to build next within CS priorities.

You will partner closely with CS Leadership, CS Operations, Marketing, Product, and Support. You are not a ticket-taker: you identify the gaps, propose the program, build it, launch it, and prove its impact.

What This Role Is – And Isn’t

This role is for someone who has done this before and does not need a runway. We need a builder and program owner, not a resource waiting to be directed.

  • You move fast and ship. Journeys launch in weeks, not months. We do not wait for perfect requirements; we iterate.
  • You lead, not just execute. You do not wait for requests. You use data to find where customers are not being engaged, then bring a proposed program, a business case, and a plan.
  • You flag blockers immediately. Unclear or missing requirements are raised the same day, with a recommendation attached.
  • You own your backlog. You prioritize your own backlog and drive to resolution. We review outputs; we do not track status.
  • You know the difference between “I need input” and “I need permission.” Judgment calls within scope get made. Questions that need business context get escalated quickly.

Key Responsibilities

Digital Program Strategy & Ownership

  • Own the strategy, roadmap, and calendar for CS digital programs across the customer lifecycle: onboarding, adoption, value realization, renewal, and expansion.
  • Design and launch strategic, segment-level programs and journeys, aligned to customer segmentation, health scoring, and CS coverage models.
  • Build the business case for each program: audience, objective, success metrics, content needs, and required resources. Prioritize the roadmap with CS Leadership.
  • Act as project and program lead for cross-functional digital initiatives, coordinating Marketing, Product, Support, Sales, and Enablement to deliver on time.
  • Pilot and evaluate new engagement channels and tactics (in-app, email, community, webinars, and others) and scale what works.

Digital Journey & Campaign Build

  • Design and build automated journeys in Gainsight, including conditional logic, multi-step triggers, and data-driven audiences.
  • Create, manage, and optimize email programs and in-app campaigns targeting customers at key lifecycle moments. Partner with Marketing and CS on messaging, and own campaign hygiene and governance.
  • Build and maintain audience segments, rules, and triggers for digital touchpoints; connect digital programs to CTAs and human-led plays so digital and CSM engagement work together.
  • A/B test content, timing, and cadence; report results and iterate.

Engagement Coverage & Gap Analysis

  • Track engagement: which customers, segments, and lifecycle stages are receiving touches, and which are not.
  • Identify and quantify gaps – unengaged accounts, stalled onboarding, low adoption, at-risk renewals with no digital or human outreach – and turn them into prioritized programs and recommendations.
  • Maintain a clear view of program progress against plan, and present findings and next steps to CS Leadership on a regular cadence.

Gainsight Platform Leader

  • Serve as the primary Gainsight Lead for Customer Success, owning building, data integrity, and platform health in regards to digital customer lifecycle.
  • Ensure Snowflake, Salesfoce, and other connectors data ingestion into Gainsight is usable for customer lifecycle programs
  • Document configurations, processes, and runbooks proactively.

Reporting, Analytics & Insights

  • Build and maintain dashboards and reports for CS Leadership
  • Track journey and program performance: reach, open and click rates, engagement, stage progression, product adoption, and influence on retention and expansion.
  • Provide regular, data-backed recommendations to improve program effectiveness and to inform coverage and resourcing decisions.

CS Ops & Leadership Partnership

  • Translate CS Leadership priorities and CS Ops workflows into programs and Gainsight builds quickly and with minimal hand-holding.
  • Participate in regular syncs with CS Ops and Leadership to gather requirements, share updates, and surface dependency gaps before they cause delays.
  • Enable CSMs to act on digital program outputs, and communicate program changes clearly.

Qualifications

Required

  • 4–6+ years in Customer Success Operations, Digital/Scaled Customer Success, or lifecycle programs, including 3–5 years of hands-on Gainsight Building (or admin level type access).
  • Proven experience designing, building, and managing Journey Orchestrator programs and email campaigns from strategy through measurement.
  • Demonstrated program or project leadership: you have owned cross-functional initiatives and delivered measurable outcomes.
  • Strong understanding of the Gainsight data model – MDA, relationships, connectors, and Rules Engine.
  • Experience with Snowflake-to-Gainsight data ingestion, including connector setup, MDA mapping, and pipeline troubleshooting.
  • Proficiency with Salesforce integrations and how Gainsight syncs with SFDC, Snowflake, and other data providers.
  • Experience using data to identify engagement gaps and turn them into prioritized programs.
  • Working knowledge of customer lifecycle management, segmentation, and health scoring in a B2B SaaS environment.
  • Ability to work independently, manage competing priorities, and deliver without oversight.
  • Track record of fast execution: you have built dashboards in a day and launched journeys in a week.
  • Strong written and verbal communication, with executive presence and the ability to document for technical and non-technical audiences.

Nice to Have

  • Gainsight Admin certification.
  • Experience with health scoring model design and maintenance.
  • Hands-on experience with Pendo, including building in-app guides and messaging, defining behavioral segments, analyzing product usage and adoption, and using insights to trigger targeted digital CS journeys
  • Experience using Claude, Microsoft Copilot, and Workato to accelerate content creation, automate workflows, and scale digital CS programs.
  • Experience with lifecycle marketing, in-app messaging, or digital customer success programs at scale.
  • Experience with Tableau or similar BI tools; familiarity with SQL.
  • Experience in a commercial or mid-market CS motion supporting a large, digitally served customer base.

What Success Looks Like

First 15 days: The Gainsight digital programs have been reviewed and the backlog is prioritized and agreed with CS Ops and CS Leadership. An initial engagement coverage baseline for the commercial book shows where customers are and are not being reached. Quick-win deliverables are shipped (dashboards, segments, reports), and at least one digital journey is live in production.

Within 30 days: Existing journeys have been updated and new programs are being launched. Full program and campaign calendar is underway. A strategic program roadmap for the Commercial book is reviewed and approved by CS Leadership. Performance and gap reporting is in place and stakeholders are reviewing results.

Within 45 days: Engagement gaps prioritized by CS Leadership have programs in market, with measurable movement in reach and engagement. A recurring cadence for program review and gap reporting is established, and digital and CSM-led motions are connected through CTAs and plays.

Typically has a Bachelor’s degree, and 9 - 11 years of experience, or equivalent relevant work experience; e.g., each year of work experience may be substituted for each year of education required.

Years of Experience

9 - 11 years

Required Skills

Technical Expertise

1.     Agile Methodology Expertise:

  • Proficient in Agile frameworks such as SAFe, Scrum, DevSecOps, and Lean Agile.
  • Experience managing Agile Release Trains and leading Agile teams.
  • Ability to oversee backlog grooming, sprint planning, daily stand-ups, retrospectives, and program increments.

2.    Software Development Lifecycle (SDLC) Knowledge:

  • Demonstrated ability to manage projects through all SDLC phases, including concept definition, design, execution, operation, maintenance, and decommissioning.
  • Familiarity with TSA Systems Engineering Lifecycle (SELC) processes and gate reviews.

3.    Risk Management:

  • Skilled in developing, maintaining, and implementing risk management plans, including risk identification, mitigation, and monitoring.
  • Ability to manage technical risks, ensure timely escalation, and coordinate risk resolution.

4.    Performance Metrics Management:

  • Ability to use Application Lifecycle Management (ALM) tools to track metrics like defect closure rates, sprint velocity, and system performance.
  • Proficient in analyzing and reporting on key performance metrics (KPPs) and quality assurance metrics.

5.    Cybersecurity Knowledge:

  • Familiarity with cybersecurity processes, including POA&M resolution and compliance with DHS IT security standards.
  • Knowledge of vulnerability scanning, risk assessments, and contingency plans for IT systems.

Program Management Expertise

6.    Strategic Planning:

  • Experience developing and maintaining Program Management Plans (PMPs) that align with organizational goals, tactical roadmaps, and technical strategy.
  • Ability to plan and track budgets, resource allocation, and schedules.

7.    Stakeholder Communication:

  • Strong communication skills to maintain effective coordination with TSA leadership, other contractors, and stakeholders.
  • Experience developing and maintaining communication plans, including RACI matrices.

8.    Team Leadership:

  • Skilled in managing cross-functional teams, including federal employees, contractors, and external vendors.
  • Ability to foster collaboration across diverse project teams to achieve shared goals.

9.    Transition Management:

  • Experience managing transition-in and transition-out phases for government contracts.
  • Ability to develop and implement staffing plans, risk management approaches, and transition project schedules.

10.    Scheduling and Resource Management:

  • Proficient in MS Project or similar tools for developing resource-loaded, resource-leveled project schedules.
  • Ability to manage both steady-state operations and fluctuating workloads.

Operational Oversight

11.    Quality Assurance:

  • Proven ability to implement and maintain Quality Assurance Plans (QAPs) and Quality Control Plans (QCPs).
  • Strong attention to detail to ensure deliverables are accurate, complete, and client-ready.

12.    Incident Management:

  • Experience handling critical incident management and root cause analysis to resolve system outages and disruptions.
  • Ability to coordinate with infrastructure contractors to identify and address issues.

13.    System and Application Support:

  • Knowledge of operations and maintenance (O&M) processes, including Tier 3 support and application-level troubleshooting.
  • Familiarity with monitoring tools for application performance and system interfaces.

Documentation and Reporting

14.    Deliverables Management:

  • Ability to ensure timely submission of deliverables, such as design documents, test plans, risk registers, and transition plans.
  • Experience tracking and reporting on program status, metrics, and burn rates.

15.    Compliance and Accessibility:

  • Knowledge of Section 508 accessibility standards and ability to ensure compliance in ICT deliverables.

Soft Skills

16.    Problem-Solving Skills:

  • Ability to proactively identify and resolve challenges, including technical and operational issues.
  • Strong analytical skills to assess program performance and recommend improvements.

17.    Leadership and Decision-Making:

  • Demonstrated leader

Preferred Skills

Preferred Certifications

1.    Project Management Professional (PMP) certification.

2.    Certified Scrum Master (CSM) or equivalent Agile certifications.

3.    SAFe Agilist (SA) or SAFe Program Consultant (SPC) certifications.

4.    Certified Information Systems Security Professional (CISSP) for cybersecurity expertise.

5.    ITIL Foundation Certification for IT service management

Working Conditions

Virtual. managing a driven Agile team.

$160,000 - $175,000 a year

Our Core Values

Employees of Agile Defense are our number one priority, and the importance we place on our culture here is fundamental. Our culture is alive and evolving, but it always stays true to its roots. jobs.title: Product Manager | Contract | Hybrid, NYC
jobs.jd_full:
About us:

Working at Tech Holding isn’t just a job, it’s an opportunity to be a part of something bigger. We are a full-service consulting firm that was founded on the premise of delivering predictable outcomes and high-quality solutions to our clients.  Our founders and team members have industry experience and have held senior positions in a wide variety of companies – from emerging startups to large Fortune 50 firms – and we have taken our combined experiences and developed a unique approach that is supported by the principles of deep expertise, integrity, transparency, and dependability.

The Role:

We’re seeking a Senior Product Manager, for a project-based assignment, you’ll be responsible for overseeing the development and lifecycle of the client’s product, a platform dedicated to combating online disinformation. You will work cross-functionally with engineering, design, marketing, and sales teams to define the product vision, prioritize features, and manage the roadmap. This is a high-impact role ideal for someone who thrives in agile environments and is passionate about purpose-driven innovation.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Work with the leadership team to develop and execute the Artemis product vision and strategy.
  • Analyze market trends, perform competitor analysis and research, and understand client needs to drive the product roadmap and pricing strategy.
  • Clearly articulate the business value of the features on the roadmap and ensure alignment across the leadership team, the technology teams and the analysis team.
  • Prioritize features on the roadmap by assessing the value to clients and their alignment with the broader product strategy and initiatives.
  • Collaborate with stakeholders to create epics and define product requirements, including functional requirements and user experience.
  • Engage with clients to gather feedback and insights, using this knowledge to inform product decisions and enhancements.
  • Stay up-to-date on industry trends and emerging technologies related to disinformation and online information ecosystems.

Requirements:

  • 4+ years of experience in a product management role responsible for cloud-based web applications.
  • Demonstrated success in developing and launching features and products, with a track record of delivering on-time, high-quality products that meet user needs.
  • Passion for the mission of combating disinformation and promoting online safety and integrity.
  • Experience working in an agile development environment using agile development tools.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills for creating epics and stories for engineering and effectively collaborating with cross-functional teams and clients.
  • Demonstrated ability to think strategically and creatively, with solid problem-solving and analytical skills.
  • Experience with prototyping, wireframing, and UI/UX design and collaboration tools such as Figma.
  • Experience with Microsoft Office 365 (Word, Excel, PowerPoint) or G Suite (Google Docs, Google Sheets, Google Slides, Google Forms).

Preferred:

  • Passion for the mission of combating disinformation and promoting online safety.

Location:

  • NYC (Hybrid – 3 days onsite per week)

What We Offer:

  • Collaborative and mission-driven team culture
  • Opportunity to contribute to impactful, socially-driven technology
  • Competitive compensation package
